description.en: Groups globally registered tools by regular expression and applies one of three states per group: leave the tools untouched, hide them from the session's tool list, or keep them behind a single on-demand gateway tool. A sidebar panel adds, edits, reorders, and deletes groups, writing them back to the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 按正则把全局注册的工具分组，每组可选一种状态：不处理、从会话工具列表中隐藏、或收在一个按需入口工具后面。左侧栏面板支持增删改分组并调整顺序，配置写回 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml。
